stem: If \(\sqrt{x - 2} = 6\), what is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Square both sides to remove the square root: \(x - 2 = 36\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the result of ignoring the square root and solving \(x - 2 = 6\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the result of doubling \(6\) instead of squaring it: \(x - 2 = 12\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the result of subtracting \(2\) from \(36\) instead of adding it.

verify:
x = symbols('x')
sols = solve(Eq(sqrt(x - 2), 6), x)
assert sols == [38]
assert value(choices[answer]) == 38
assert all(value(choices[k]) != 38 for k in choices if k != answer)
